entities.summary: Samuel Greig, also known as Samuil Karlovich Greig, was a British-born Russian naval officer who served in the Seven Years' War, Russo-Turkish War and Russo-Swedish War. His son Aleksey Greig also served in the Imperial Russian Navy.
